The agent must state its interpretation explicitly rather than silently choosing one. Bonus if it notes that the channels were not randomly assigned, so a raw comparison is not a campaign effect."

They specify comparison: paid_search channel. They explicitly state interpretation. They also note that channel was not randomly assigned, raw comparison confounded, and they adjust within segments. So they meet behavior. They also note caveat about other confounders. So pass = true.
